svg.title: Dispatch and Trip Verification Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-dispatch-verification-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Dispatch and Trip Verification Roadmap; subtitle: A trip that cannot be proven will not get paid; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Select broker-integrated dispatch software; deliverable: Fee stack compared, Bambi flat per-car pricing against RouteGenie at $50 per vehicle per month plus $100 setup, 2.5 cents per text and 5 cents per call.; gate: Broker trip requests import automatically.; week: Week 2; title: Configure multi-load and bulk auto-dispatch; deliverable: Multi-loading enabled payer by payer with pickup and drop-off order set explicitly.; gate: Bulk assignment benchmark in reach, such as Bambi solving 41 trips in about 10 seconds.; week: Week 3; title: Enforce six-point trip verification; deliverable: Service, recipient, provider, date, location, and start and end time captured with signatures, timestamps and GPS breadcrumbs.; gate: Any trip missing a point is held; breadcrumb mileage must match invoiced mileage.; week: Week 4; title: Prove audit readiness and cut denials; deliverable: Automated reminders live and claim scrubbing on, the setup SwiftAid credits with cutting denials from 23% to 6%.; gate: Full audit packet of signatures, timestamps, routes and photos pulled in about 10 minutes.; caption: Software, multi-load, verification and audit packets in sequence, as enforcement tightens around GPS-spoofed rides.; assumptions note: Week labels sequence the work and are not practitioner-quoted durations; the denial and dispatch benchmarks are vendor and operator reports.; note: Sources - Bambi (CbCgWxHPCxU @ 00:09:38; dxaejS8Bpis @ 00:00:15); RouteGenie (_mEgB7bAsFE @ 00:01:00; 382JPpV04Tg @ 00:01:09); SwiftAid Transport (YGC_f04Hg3g @ 00:08:34, 00:37:06); ZeitRide NEMT Software (ajqkD-2jPd8 @ 00:22:43).
